title: A lock in acre-gui stops edits, and agents open the viewer locked
body:
acre-gui edits the source on drags, handles, reorders, creation tools, Delete, paste, Duplicate, arrow keys, double-click text edits and the properties panel. When an agent opens a figure to show Jack, a stray drag changes the file.

## Proposal

- A `Lock` toggle on the toolbar, near `Snap` and `Grid`. No key.
- `acre-gui --locked [FILE]` starts locked; the toolbar can unlock it.
- While locked, every source edit is blocked: drags (they neither move nor preview), every handle, reorder, the creation tools (shown disabled), Delete, paste, Duplicate, arrow-key moves, double-click text edits, and property changes (the panel shows values read-only). A blocked action changes nothing and the status line says "locked".
- Still allowed: selection, including a click moving neovim's cursor; box selection; pan, zoom and fit; Ctrl+C; playback.
- The `acre-figures` skill tells agents to pass `--locked` when they open a figure to show Jack.
close_reason: Landed on dev in 60d64ff (the Lock toggle, `--locked`, and every edit refused while locked) and in the acre-figures skill, which now tells agents to open the viewer with `acre-gui --locked FILE`.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/0c799e42
notes.text: The acre-gui part landed in commit 60d64ff. `App::write` refuses an edit while `View::locked` is set. The toolbar's Lock toggle and `acre-gui --locked` set it. A press on an object or a handle while locked comes to a click, through `press` in `view.rs` and `Drag::click`. The `acre-figures` skill still has to tell agents to pass `--locked`.
